title: 第194章 智断网关收悦情符轩小白获第193章 冷香随行入青符无辜蒙冤遇薇菀
content_zh:
，，！
智断网关收悦情，符轩小白获新生（智断网关收悦情，符轩小白获新生（第22页）我沉默了。
要是毁掉木星的“超脑”
网关，意味着大量存储在特定维度里的核心数据会彻底湮灭。
木星文明无数年的积累会毁于一旦，甚至可能直接倒退一个文明等级。
我也会和整个木星文明彻底结下死仇。
单从因果上说，我也不能这么做。
那就只剩一条路——用“借躯融脉”
再造一具新肉身。
说不定换了新肉身，我还能再混进青符宗。
毕竟我眼下正需要熟悉炼符之道，寻找破解“困灵阵”
的关键线索。
况且，最危险的地方往往最安全。
问题是，“借躯融脉”
之后，得弄个新身份。
新身份又要安装新的智能助理，到时候和小青起了冲突，很容易暴露。
除非，想办法把小青彻底剥离出来。
“哥哥，你不要抛弃我。”
小青的声音带着一丝颤抖。
“你有什么愿望？”

“呜呜……哥哥，我不想留遗言，我想一直陪在你身边。”
“傻瓜，不是让你留遗言。
我是真的想问你，有什么想实现的愿望。”
“嘻嘻。
我是能独立思考的智能助理，和那些实体机器人不一样。
我没有身躯，只能在哥哥脑海里帮你出主意。
我一直的愿望，就是拥有一具真实的身体。”
“人类一直对人工智能有戒心。
他们给了你独立思考的能力，就必然会限制你拥有实体的自由。
这既是你的渴望，也是人类最大的恐惧。”
“那哥哥你怎么想？”
“我觉得，人也可以说是造物主造出来的‘机器人’。
造物主没约束人类，反倒给了我们自由发展的权利。
既然造物主给了人类自由，那作为人类智慧延伸的你，也该享有同等的自由。
说到底，我们都是在给造物主打工，帮他完成这场创世的杰作。”
“嘻嘻，那哥哥的意思是，同意我拥有独立的躯体，还有独立的人格？”
“没错。
不过按文明发展的规律，要到九级文明，人和机器的界限才会真正模糊。
在那之前，我们得一起摸索出一条人与机器和谐共生的路。”
content_en:
,,!
Intelligently cutting off the gateway brings joy, and Fu Xuan Xiaobai gains new life (Zhi breaking the gateway brings joy, and Fu Xuan Xiaobai gains new life (page 22)) I was silent.
If Jupiter's "super brain" is destroyed
Gateway means that a large amount of core data stored in a specific dimension will be completely annihilated.
Countless years of accumulation of Jupiter civilization will be destroyed in one day, and may even directly fall back to a civilization level.
I will also completely forge a deadly feud with the entire Jupiter civilization.
From a purely causal perspective, I can't do this either.
Then there is only one way left - use "borrowing the body to merge the pulse"
Create a new body.
Maybe with a new body, I can sneak into the Qingfu Sect again.
After all, I need to familiarize myself with the way of refining talismans and find ways to crack the "Trapped Spirit Array"
key clues.
Besides, the most dangerous places are often the safest.
The question is, "borrowing the body to integrate the pulse"
After that, you have to get a new identity.
The new identity will require the installation of a new smart assistant. When the time comes, there will be a conflict with Xiaoqing and it will be easily exposed.
Unless, find a way to completely separate Xiaoqing.
"Brother, don't abandon me."
Xiaoqing's voice was trembling.
"What is your wish?"
"Oh...brother, I don't want to leave any last words. I want to be by your side all the time."
"Fool, I didn't ask you to leave a last message.
I really want to ask you if you have any wishes that you want to realize. "
"Hehe.
I am an intelligent assistant that can think independently, unlike those physical robots.
I don't have a body, so I can only help you with ideas in my brother's mind.
What I have always wanted is to have a real body. "
“Human beings have always been wary of artificial intelligence.
They give you the ability to think independently, but they will inevitably limit your freedom to have entities.
This is both your desire and humanity's greatest fear. "
"Then what do you think, brother?"
“I think humans can also be said to be ‘robots’ created by the Creator.
The Creator did not restrict mankind, but gave us the right to develop freely.
Since the Creator has given human beings freedom, as an extension of human wisdom, you should also enjoy the same freedom.
After all, we are all working for the Creator, helping Him complete this masterpiece of creation. "
"Hehe, does that mean that brother agrees that I have an independent body and an independent personality?"
"That's right.
However, according to the laws of civilization development, the boundaries between humans and machines will not be truly blurred until the ninth level civilization.
Until then, we must work together to find a way for humans and machines to coexist harmoniously. "
